name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.222.0 — The prototype freeze signs in and derives its tier. A host may declare prototype.storageState, a saved Playwright sign-in that every capture loads — at the freeze and at the build's capture gate; a non-string, missing or unreadable file refuses by name before a browser launches, and a login redirect names the stale sign-in or says to declare one. /spec:doctor flags a committed storageState file. The generated spec's tier is no longer hardcoded standard: --mark tests-derived matches the File Plan against the host's pipeline rules § Risk Tiers paths, and any hit refuses until the user passes --tier standard|critical; the spec's Rationale records the basis and the mark prints the derived tier. The grounding contract gains the storageState key, so the contract hash changes and hosts owe a /spec:doctor re-stamp. 7.221.0 — Build capture gate joins prototype.url onto the relative route addresses the freeze writes in contract.json — a real frozen contract no longer dies on an invalid address at --mark captured; a relative address with no prototype.url declared is refused by name. 7.220.0 — Prototype lane fixes from the walkthrough host: --mark opened no longer checks the overlay import (the import lives on the prototype branch that opened creates), so a host without it on main no longer wedges as a stale branch — --mark round-done refuses until some file imports the overlay, records it as status.wiring, and the generated spec's File Plan drops that file when its diff is the import alone. An absolute brief path resolves instead of being joined under the root, and the Data/API sub-plan is written before harden/<stem> exists, so a failed write leaves no branch to wedge the rerun. proto-capture refuses when the page settles on a different path than requested (a signed-out login redirect was recorded as the route's baseline) and names a production build when fibers carry no _debugOwner. The overlay's queue bar and panel respect the safe-area inset, sit above host chrome, and flip to the top edge on tap.
